title: Skein ecosystem manifest
description: Each repo in the skein ecosystem (opencode-skein, llama-skein, skein) carries a skein.json at its root following this schema. tantonet.se/skein (the my-astro-site repo) fetches each repo's skein.json at build time and aggregates them into the ecosystem page, so the source of truth for what a project does lives with the project's code. Update a feature here, and the site reflects it on next build.

tagline.description: One-line pitch for the ecosystem page card

kind.description: What sort of project this is

install.description: Install one-liners by channel; omit channels that don't apply

features.description: The cool stuff. This is what the ecosystem page sells and what keeps you from forgetting what each repo can do.

upstreamable.description: For forks: can this be proposed to upstream as-is (yes), after decoupling (partial), not without an upstream abstraction (no), or not applicable (na)

depends.description: Other skein ids this feature depends on, e.g. llama-skein

updated.description: ISO date of last manifest update
